query:
SELECT s.nome, ROUND(SUM(CAST(pdi.quantidade AS DECIMAL(10,2))), 1) as totalViagens
FROM parte_diaria pd
JOIN parte_diaria_itens pdi ON pdi.parteDiariaId = pd.id
JOIN setores s ON pdi.setorId = s.id
WHERE pd.data BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30'
GROUP BY s.nome
ORDER BY totalViagens DESC
